theme_notes: Trump hosted Xi Jinping at a White House state dinner (sea bass, a bald eagle gift, and a table of Musk/Bezos/Altman/Jensen Huang); the UNGA hit peak dysfunction with world leaders publicly declaring the UN is failing and debating the US bombing of Iran as a charter violation; Hurricane Nolo made landfall on Hawaii's Big Island; and Pope Leo XIV touched down in Paris for the first papal France visit in nearly 20 years.
